name: bld5_pisano_prime_le_four_mul
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld4_pisano_prime_dvd_pred_of_isSquare_five, Mathlib2.bld4_pisano_prime_dvd_two_mul_succ_of_not_isSquare_five, Mathlib2.lib_fib_period_iff and Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period: for p = 2 and p = 5 check F_3 ≡ 0, F_4 ≡ 1 mod 2 and F_20 ≡ 0, F_21 ≡ 1 mod 5, so (lib_fib_period_iff, bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period) pisano ∣ 3 resp. 20 = 4·5 (equality case). Otherwise split on IsSquare (5 : ZMod p): the first bld4 theorem gives pisano ∣ p − 1, the second pisano ∣ 2(p+1) ≤ 4p; conclude with Nat.le_of_dvd.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Mathlib2.p3_pisano p ≤ 4 * p
